input_reference: 2D architectural elevation drawing of a built-in media wall with central TV, upper open shelving grid, and lower shaker cabinets
output_goal: Photorealistic 3D rendering that faithfully matches the proportions, layout, and millwork of the reference elevation
prompt: Create a photorealistic, interior-design-quality 3D rendering of the built-in media wall shown in the attached elevation drawing. Preserve the exact layout, proportions, and compartment counts from the drawing. The final rendered image must NOT contain any dimension lines, measurement annotations, inch marks, leader lines, arrows, or drafting labels — it should look like a finished interior photograph. Render as a finished, furnished room view, camera roughly eye-level, straight-on to slightly angled (5-10 degrees) to show depth, with soft natural daylight from the left and warm fill lighting from the room.

subject.type: floor-to-ceiling built-in media / entertainment wall unit
subject.style: transitional modern with classical shaker detailing

overall_layout_top_to_bottom.description: Flat horizontal frieze band spanning the full width at the top, with a small rectangular inset panel in the upper-left containing an X marker (represent as a discreet integrated ventilation / speaker grille panel, subtly recessed, matching cabinet finish)
Four-column-wide open shelving grid flanking and surrounding a central wall-mounted TV

grid.tv_placement: centered, spans the inner two columns across the bottom two rows of the upper grid, leaving the outer columns as tall two-row open cubbies on each side
grid.shelf_construction: thin flat shelves with mitered front edges, recessed into a face-frame grid; back panels painted to match case
grid.styling: sparsely styled with books laid flat and upright, small ceramic vessels, a brass sculpture, a framed art print, a trailing pothos plant, and a pair of stacked linen-bound boxes — leave roughly 40% of cubbies empty for breathing room

overall_layout_top_to_bottom.description: 50-inch LG QNED flat-panel TV, wall-mounted flush within the central opening, bezel-less, screen off (dark) or showing a neutral abstract cloudscape identical to the reference; centered horizontally; opening height about 38 inches as dimensioned
Slim horizontal rail / countertop element separating the upper open shelving from the lower base cabinets, same finish as casework

Row of six shaker-style cabinet doors across the full width, equal widths, classic inset shaker profile with a single recessed flat panel and a narrow reveal between doors; minimal low-profile brushed brass or matte black knob hardware centered on the upper rail of each door
Clean recessed toe-kick with a simple flat baseboard plinth beneath the lower cabinets, matching the casework color

dimensions_from_drawing.use_these_as_anchor: Scale every other element proportionally from the 50" TV width and 38" opening height shown in the drawing

materials_and_finish.casework: painted MDF in warm off-white (Benjamin Moore White Dove / Simply White equivalent), matte finish, crisp reveals
materials_and_finish.interior_backs_of_open_cubbies: same paint, or optional very subtle warm taupe for depth
materials_and_finish.hardware: small round brushed-brass knobs on lower cabinet doors
materials_and_finish.floor: wide-plank white oak hardwood, matte finish, natural tone
materials_and_finish.ceiling: flat white with a simple shadow-line reveal

lighting.key_light: soft diffused daylight from the left, as if from an off-camera window
lighting.accent: subtle integrated LED strip lighting under each open shelf, gently grazing the back panels
lighting.tv_state: screen showing the same LG QNED cloudscape image as the reference, slightly glowing
lighting.exposure: balanced, no blown highlights; gentle contrast

camera.framing: full built-in visible with a small margin of room on either side and the floor in the foreground
camera.angle: straight-on elevation view with a 5-10 degree rotation to reveal the thickness of the case and slight depth of shelves
camera.height: eye-level, around 60 inches off the floor
camera.aspect_ratio: 4:5 or 1:1 portrait-leaning for the full wall

style_and_mood.aesthetic: architectural digest, warm minimalist, editorial interior photography
style_and_mood.render_quality: photorealistic, crisp edges, accurate shadows, no CGI plasticiness
style_and_mood.color_palette: warm neutrals, soft whites, natural oak, muted brass, a few greenery accents

faithfulness_rules: Preserve the exact proportions, compartment sizes, and spacing shown in the elevation — use the 50" TV width and 38" opening height only as internal scale references, never draw them.
Keep the exact compartment count: 4 columns in the upper shelving grid, 6 doors in the lower cabinet bank.
Keep the TV centered and sized relative to surrounding cubbies exactly as drawn.
Preserve the header band at the top with the single offset inset panel on the left side.
Do not add crown molding, fluted details, or fireplace elements that are not in the drawing.
Do not change the door style from shaker to raised-panel or slab.
Do not add glass doors to the upper cubbies — they remain open shelving.

CRITICAL: The final rendered image must contain no dimension labels, no '38"' or '50"' text, no leader/arrow lines, no tick marks, and no drafting annotations of any kind. Render only the finished, real-world built-in as it would appear in a photograph.
negative_prompt: no fisheye distortion, no warped proportions, no extra cabinets, no fireplace, no crown molding, no glass doors on shelves, no clutter, no text or watermarks, no cartoon or illustrative style, no people, no pets, NO dimension lines, NO measurement annotations, NO inch marks, NO '38"' or '50"' labels, NO leader lines, NO arrows, NO drafting tick marks, NO construction guides — the final output must look like a finished photograph with zero drafting overlay

parts.text: Using the attached 2D elevation drawing as the authoritative layout reference, generate a photorealistic 3D interior rendering of this built-in media wall. PRESERVE ALL PROPORTIONS EXACTLY as drawn (use the 50" TV width and 38" opening height only as internal scale references — do NOT include any dimension lines, measurement labels, leader lines, arrows, tick marks, or '38"'/'50"' text in the output). Match the exact compartment counts: 4-column upper open shelving grid surrounding a centered LG QNED TV, and 6 shaker-style lower cabinet doors. Finish: warm off-white painted casework, white oak floor, brushed brass knobs, soft daylight from the left, editorial interior photography quality. Preserve the header band with the small offset inset panel in the upper left, and do not add crown molding, glass doors, or fireplace elements. Style the open cubbies lightly with books, ceramics, and a trailing plant; leave about 40% of cubbies empty. 35mm lens, eye-level, 5-10 degree angle to show depth. Output must look like a finished interior photograph with zero drafting overlay.
